topics.summary: Howard discusses training his program assistant, referring to him as a "lackey." He intends to mold the assistant’s behavior like former employee Pat using tranquilizers and meticulous control, while also addressing concerns about Rolling Stone reporter Steve Martin and attempts to influence an interview with Bob Goldwite.
